title: BPW-2026-0609
text:
[CONSENT ITEM(S)]
BPW-2026-0609
CD ALL
The Mayor has approved and authorized the Board of Public Works to execute the Amendments with CJM Petroleum Consulting, Inc. and Baker & O’Brien, Inc. for the continued provision of Research and Analysis for the Oil Well Amortization Study.
(C-142696, C-142695)
(REF: BPW-2026-0056)
summary: Mayor-approved amendments extending two consultants' research and analysis for the city's Oil Well Amortization Study.

details.applicant: CJM Petroleum Consulting, Inc. and Baker & O'Brien, Inc.
